children: to allow the social media company’s artificial intelligence agent Muse to complete purchases on behalf of users across Shopify stores.
This allows Muse users to shop at Shopify stores and complete purchases through Shop Pay, Shopify's accelerated checkout service.

"We are partnering deeply with Muse to enable agentic checkout with Shop Pay on all Shopify stores, offering people an easy and delightful way to shop and check out with Muse," said Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke.
Muse was launched by Meta earlier this month and is designed to carry out tasks for users, including finding products and completing online purchases. On Monday, Amazon

Muse from shopping on its website. Amazon said third-party applications making purchases on behalf of customers should respect a retailer's decision on whether to participate and said it had asked Meta to remove Amazon from Muse.
The third-party bots could jeopardize Amazon's lucrative ad business by bypassing its native storefront.

title: Meta, Shopify team up to enable purchases through Muse AI agent
